name: Ratu Udre Udre Tomb
bio_draft: Historic site: tomb of 19th-century chief Udre Udre, said to have eaten hundreds of people, near Vaileka.

name: Navatu Rock
bio_draft: Landmark: rock beside Kings Road in Vitawa village that looks like a man or a woman depending on the angle; one of Fiji's oldest settlement sites.

name: Fiji Museum
bio_draft: Museum: national museum of Fiji's history and archaeology (artefacts about 3,700 years old), in Thurston Gardens, Suva; paid entry.

name: Colo-i-Suva Forest Reserve
bio_draft: Nature park: rainforest reserve about 10 minutes from central Suva, with Waisila Falls, swimming pools, trails and birdlife.

name: Suva Municipal Market
bio_draft: Market: daily fruit and vegetable market on Harris Road, Suva (Mon-Sat), south of the bus station.

name: Mount Korobaba
bio_draft: Viewpoint: hill walk above Lami with city and harbour views; the walk starts behind the cement works in Lami.
